title: Deferred readouts on the cyclic-strip complex network: conditional κ = 9.39074e-5
body:
**Validation complete:** full repository coverage passed (78 isolated test modules, 20 historical patch checks), both fresh producer replays passed, and all 36 corrected research-head CI checks passed. The original full invocation tested `4dcb515`; a separate replay checked the expanded-charge certificate at `070b4d6` after verifying unchanged producer/profile bytes. Both logs and exact commit coverage are recorded in `research/deferred-cyclic/validation.json`.

Conditional κ = 469537/5000000000 = **9.39074×10⁻⁵**, **+9.39% over #110** (429239/5·10⁹), +9.47% over #111.

#110 showed that deferred readouts pay on both stopped networks under #104's one-child-per-residual rule; its binding side was the complex network on #104's unchanged h=24 DAG. #111 found a much smaller complex DAG (cyclic interval strips in the PairedTriple recursion + #108's dual-suffix pair stars). This PR runs **#110's deferral pipeline verbatim** on that DAG.

| h=24 complex | #110 | this |
|---|---:|---:|
| matched carriers | 8,966 | 37,802 |
| roles R | 44,918 | **38,506** |
| deferred roles | 8,893 | 5,887 |
| complex saving (binding) | 8.58628e-5 | **9.39253e-5** |
| κ | 8.58478e-5 | **9.39074e-5** |

Bit side: #110's one-child profile of Swapnil Jain's round-seven deferred word, unchanged (stopped saving 1.24019e-4).

Checks: `complex_deferred.py` (maximum carrier matching under the inherited adjacency, explicit role compile, lifted binary frames, deferral, replay with arbitrary scratch, exact F2 frame checks; pins 37,802 links / 38,506 roles) and `certificate.py` (exact moments, next-grid rejection of coarse bit saving, complex saving and κ, 47 strict constraints, 7 margins; requires κ above #110 and #111). Scope and stated-but-unchecked steps are exactly #110's (PROOF.md, with an addendum).

Credit: Avi Eisenberg (#110, #62), Swapnil Jain (deferred readouts), icekylinx (#104), Rohan Gupta / gupt1156 (#55 dual-suffix layout), #107–#109/#111, and all predecessors in #104's NOTICE/SOURCES. Composition by Rohan Arun with Anthropic Claude assistance.


Independent local verification reproduced #110’s baseline profile and this branch’s complete complex profile exactly, and reran the exact certificate. Complete repository and corrected-certificate coverage has now passed, as documented above. The inherited complex stage-two complement/time-reversal argument and all-size interfaces remain written proof dependencies; these finite checks do not establish those general arguments.


CI status: the initial joint jobs failed at an inherited Makefile fingerprint, before the new construction checks. The three stale inherited root-file fingerprints (Makefile, README.md, NOTICE) were repaired. The original independent h23/h25 physical verifier passed, including full dirty-basis replay, all frame paths/profiles and exact recurrence checks. The derived certificates differ only in checksum metadata; mathematical values are unchanged and no check is disabled. A full corrected-head rerun is starting.


**Scalar-accounting correction (credited to eumemic #114):** the inherited original-DAG charge did not explicitly cover expanded deferred readouts. The certificate now charges their complete literal operations, raising G from 2,019,773,888 to 76,407,506,746,560 and recomputing precision constants/cutoffs. κ and both physical profiles are unchanged. Independent exact recertification passes all 47 constraints, seven margins and next-grid exclusions. The full run continues on the preceding fingerprint-repaired commit; its final coverage will be combined with an explicitly recorded replay of this corrected certificate before readiness. #114 now reports a larger κ; this PR is no longer the current record.
